study_design: Prospective cohort study of initially cancer-free men, with a separate postdiagnosis survival analysis.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: We conducted a prospective cohort study among 20,167 men participating in the Physician's Health Study who were free of cancer in 1983.
reason: The abstract analyzes overall incident prostate cancer. Its prostate cancer mortality estimates come from a survival analysis restricted to men already diagnosed with prostate cancer and therefore are not aggressive incidence endpoints.

estimate_classifications.reason: The supplied full-text evidence identifies the seafood n-3 estimate as overall incident prostate cancer. The abstract confirms that incidence was analyzed but does not report this numeric incidence estimate. The numeric mortality estimates in the abstract are postdiagnosis survival results and do not change this row to aggressive.
